name: codemap-graph-rag
description: Ask business questions about your code: @codemap answers from the Code Map graph (APIs, tables, batch jobs, business dictionary) with file:line evidence.

chatParticipants.name: codemap
chatParticipants.description: Ask about business flows, tables, APIs and batch jobs

commands.name: impact
commands.description: What reads, writes or depends on this table / API / procedure

commands.name: flow
commands.description: End-to-end flow from a screen, API or job down to the data

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Business role of the active file (or selection)

commands.name: gaps
commands.description: Business terms, jobs and references the graph cannot connect

languageModelTools.name: codemap_query
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the business concepts, code, tables and jobs related to a question.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches the Code Map knowledge graph of this codebase (screens, APIs, methods, PL/SQL, SQL files, tables, columns, batch jobs) together with the business dictionary (business terms in Vietnamese/English/Japanese and their code aliases). Returns numbered facts with file:line evidence. Use it for questions about business meaning, data lineage (who reads or writes a table), end-to-end flows and batch jobs, before reading source files.

question.description: The question or the names to look up, in any language.

mode.description: ask (default): related facts; impact: who depends on the named item; flow: follow calls/data downstream.

languageModelTools.name: codemap_file_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: What the graph knows about a source file: its APIs, methods, tables it touches and business terms.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns what the Code Map graph knows about one source file: the nodes declared in it (APIs, methods, procedures, screens), the tables and APIs they reach, the batch jobs that start them and the business terms linked to them, with file:line evidence.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path of the source file.

codemap.databasePath.description: Path to codemap-rag.sqlite. Empty: the first codemap-rag.sqlite found in the workspace.

codemap.sourceRoot.description: Folder the evidence paths are relative to. Empty: the root recorded by the extract, then the workspace folders.

codemap.extract.configPath.description: Extract config JSON (the one passed to `code_tree_exporter extract --config`).

codemap.extract.enginePath.description: Folder containing the code_tree_exporter package (the code-map repository).

codemap.extract.python.description: Python executable used to run the extract.

codemap.retrieval.maxNodes.description: Maximum graph nodes put into one answer's context.

codemap.retrieval.hops.description: How far to walk the graph from the matched nodes.

codemap.retrieval.maxContextChars.description: Character budget of the facts sent to the model.

scripts.test: node esbuild.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-force-exit out/test/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o codemap-graph-rag.vsix
